Decided: no. Source-app metadata pays off only in passive clipboard historians (icons/filters/exclude lists); Pewter's explicit-capture model has no consumer, and TUI captures can't be attributed correctly anyway. Format reserved in notes: source=<bundle-id> appended after created= in the sl comment, parser tolerance widened one release ahead, if a consuming feature ever ships.

Decided: keep current behavior. Live-tested Finder does NOT move selection on right-click of an unselected row — it outline-highlights the clicked row and acts on it, which is the AppKit default and exactly Pewter's targets(for:) pattern per NSTableView.clickedRow docs. The bead's premise was wrong; current implementation is the native convention.
